hero.summary_en: Limited New Jersey 2026 approved-date Calendar: Monmouth Park Thoroughbred, Meadowlands Thoroughbred turf and Far Hills steeplechase. The United States nationwide multi-code Calendar remains incomplete.
hero.summary_ja: 米国はNew Jersey州の2026年承認日程のみ部分対応。Monmouth平地、Meadowlands芝平地、Far Hills障害を含むが、全米・全体系の網羅には至っていない。

paragraphs_en: A 2026 New Jersey Racing Commission state-issued calendar provides precisely 50 Monmouth Park Thoroughbred, 9 Meadowlands Thoroughbred turf and 1 Far Hills steeplechase dates; date/venue/code only, rank C. These approved dates can change and do not alone prove whether a meeting ultimately ran.

No Equibase automated feed or racetrack operator website scraping is used. Other states and racing codes, including Standardbred, Quarter Horse and Arabian, are not covered by this one-regulator route.
paragraphs_ja: NJ州競馬委員会公表の2026年承認日程はMonmouth平地50日、Meadowlands芝9日、Far Hills障害1日の計60日。C級の日付・会場・体系のみで、承認後の中止や変更可能性は別途扱う。
Equibaseの自動取得や競馬場運営サイトの自動収集は行わない。この州政府資料だけでは、他州やStandardbred、Quarter Horse、Arabianなどは未対応。
